claude_only.name: Which authoritative master system already identifies this place, and what is its identifier value and namespace?
What persistent HTTP URI resolves to this place record, and who guarantees that it will not be reused?
Does the identifier remain unchanged when the place is renamed, reclassified or re-delimited, and what evidence supports that?
How are two candidate records determined to denote the same place rather than two distinct places?
Which location type does this place instantiate, and what definition and territory of use does that type declare?
Which gazetteer register is authoritative for this geographic identifier, and what is that register's declared scope?
What position does the geographic identifier resolve to, and is that a point, an extent or both?
Which alternative geographic identifiers (codes, legacy keys, statistical codes) also denote this location instance?
For each spelling of this name, what is the text, the script code and the transliteration or romanization scheme applied?
What language is each name asserted in, and how is an undetermined or multi-language name handled?
What Unicode normalization, diacritic and case-folding rules apply before comparison or indexing?
Which name is official, under whose authority, and for which territory and usage domain?
Is each name an endonym or an exonym, and against which language community is that judged?
How is the single display label chosen when several names compete, and does the choice vary by audience locale?
Which variant, historical or deprecated names must be retained for search recall even though they are not displayed?
Which controlled vocabulary and version supplies the place type, and what is the concept URI?
What local or source-supplied type label was recorded, and how does it map to the governed concept?
Can this place hold more than one type simultaneously, and which one is preferred?
When the type changes, is that a real-world change or a correction, and how is each recorded?
Which geometry is the default for this place, and on what basis was it selected?
What role does each geometry play — representative point, bounding envelope, delimited extent or approximate footprint?
If the place has no geometry, what is the reason and what indirect position can still be resolved?
How certain is each geometry, and which citation supports it?
In which coordinate reference system are the stored coordinates expressed, and where is that declaration carried?
What axis order, units and decimal precision are used, and is that consistent across every encoding offered?
If coordinates were transformed from a source CRS, which transformation was applied and what error does it introduce?
How are geometries crossing the antimeridian or the poles represented?
What is the stated positional accuracy of the recorded position, and how was it determined?
Between which most-detailed and least-detailed viewing scales is this geometry fit to be shown?
Does the number of decimal places recorded overstate the real accuracy, and has spurious precision been removed?
Has the position been deliberately generalized, and by what method and magnitude?
Over what interval did this place exist, and are the start and end known, approximate or open?
Which named historical period vocabulary terms scope this place, and from which period authority?
Is the place currently extant, and if not, what event ended its existence?
Which calendar and time zone apply to the recorded dates, and how are pre-modern or proleptic dates handled?
Over which interval was each name in use or official, and how precisely is that known?
What renaming events affected this place, and what decision authorised each?
How does the decision date differ from the effective date and from the date the record was updated?
May two official names be valid simultaneously, and if so under which authorities or languages?
When did this record version become current and when was it superseded?
What are the event time, the observation time and the ingestion time for each asserted change?
Which fields are human-curated and protected from automated overwrite, and who set that protection?
What changed between two versions, and is the change a correction, a real-world change or a re-derivation?
Which records does this record supersede, and which records supersede it?
Is the succession a merge of duplicates, a split, an absorption, a re-scoping or a retraction of an erroneous record?
What must a resolver return when a client requests a superseded identifier?
How are downstream consumers and concordance partners notified of a supersession?
Which body has the authority to decide the official name of this place, and under what legal or institutional mandate?
On whom is the official name binding, and where is it merely recommended?
Do several authorities claim competence over this place, and how is precedence determined?
Is naming competence delegated to state, regional, municipal or Indigenous naming bodies for this feature class?
Who proposed the name, what documentation accompanied the proposal, and when was it lodged?
Which naming policies were applied to the proposal, and did any of them bar it?
Which parties were consulted, and how were their responses weighed in the decision?
What is the decision date, the effective date and the date the decision was reflected in the gazetteer?
Can the decision be reconsidered or appealed, and what triggers a review?
Which parties assert competing names or claims over this place, and what does each assert?
Which name is presented to which audience, and what disclaimer accompanies the presentation?
Is the place's parentage or sovereignty recorded as unknown, complicated, contested or multiple rather than resolved?
Who adjudicates a naming dispute inside the adopting Dimension, and what is the escalation path?
Under what licence and attribution requirement may this record be redistributed, and do any source licences restrict downstream use?
How frequently is the record reviewed or refreshed, and what is the maximum acceptable staleness?
How does a consumer report a suspected error, and what is the commitment to respond?
Which source attests each individual name, type, geometry and relation, rather than the record as a whole?
Is the evidence a documentary attestation, a field observation, a derivation from another dataset or an editorial inference?
Which contributor supplied the assertion, and who exercised final editorial control over it?
When two sources conflict on a name, date or position, which prevails and on what recorded basis?
Which assertions were produced by automated extraction or model inference, and are they distinguishable from human-verified ones?
Which parent is preferred for this place, in which hierarchy, and over which interval?
Which additional hierarchies does this place belong to, and are their ancestor chains stored explicitly?
How is an unknown, complicated, contested or multiple parentage recorded without asserting a false parent?
What prevents cycles, orphans and type-inconsistent parenthood in the hierarchy?
Which topological relation vocabulary is used, and is the relation asserted or computed from geometry?
Which non-spatial associative relations apply, such as capital-of, successor-of or seat-of?
Do same-type places overlap where they should partition space, and how is that anomaly recorded?
Where no geometry exists, how is relative position expressed and against which reference place?
For each external identifier, is the link an exact match, a close match, a topic-of link or merely a see-also?
What evidence supported the match, and who or what performed it?
How is a concordance revalidated when the external record is superseded, deprecated or redefined?
What happens when two external authorities that are both linked as exact matches disagree with each other?
Which encodings and profiles are offered for this record, and which is normative when they disagree?
What information is lost or flattened in each projection, such as temporally scoped names in plain GeoJSON?
Which query parameters must the interface support, and how are temporal filters expressed?
At which stable path or URI is an individual place item addressed, and how does that relate to the place URI?
How are model elements with no native slot in an encoding carried, and are those extensions documented?
What sensitivity category applies to this place, on what grounds, and who decided it?
What generalization or withholding was applied, at what magnitude, and where is the precise value retained?
How is the fact of generalization or withholding disclosed to consumers without revealing the sensitive detail?
Who may receive the unredacted record, under what agreement, and how is that release logged?
When is the sensitivity status next reviewed, and what would justify downgrading or removing it?
Which schemas, shapes or rule sets is this record validated against, and at which version?
Which elements are mandatory for a record to be publishable, and what happens to records that fail?
Which semantic constraints beyond structural validity are enforced, such as type-consistent parenthood or geometry inside the parent extent?
What quality measures are published for the dataset, and against which intended uses?
Is a conformance claim to an external standard supported by executed test evidence, or is it only an alignment?
How long are current records, superseded versions, change logs and evidence dossiers retained, and under what obligation?
What does the register return for a deprecated or erroneous record, and what minimum information does the tombstone carry?
When a lawful erasure request affects part of a record, which elements are removed and which are preserved?
Under what circumstances, if any, may a retired identifier be reused, and how is that prevented by default?

grok_only.name: What master-system identifier uniquely identifies this gazetteer place in the authoritative names register?
Which organisation and register is authoritative for this identifier in the adopting Dimension?
Which former, merged or superseded identifiers must still resolve to this place?
Is the identifier guaranteed stable across record versions, and under what merge or split events may it change?
What governed IRI identifies the place concept as distinct from any document about it?
Which external gazetteer, thesaurus or authority identifiers are asserted as same-place concordances?
If no master-system identifier or governed IRI exists, what UUID or ULID did the adopting Dimension assign?
Which gazetteer or names register holds this location instance?
What is the register-item status of this location in that gazetteer?
What is the territory of use and language or character-set scope of the gazetteer?
Which location class or classes does this place instantiate in the geographic-identifier spatial reference system?
Which spatial reference system using geographic identifiers governs this location class?
Who owns the location class definition and in which territory is it valid?
What is the preferred or standardized name of this place for default display and indexing?
What variant, alternate, official, abbreviated or coded names are recorded for this place?
How is this name disambiguated from homographs, including parent string, qualifier or noted-homograph flag?
Does each name form have its own persistent term identifier distinct from the place identifier?
In which language or languages is each name form tagged, and which form is preferred per language?
What script is used for each spelling and which official romanization or transliteration scheme produced any converted form?
Is each name an endonym, an exonym, or another nativeness category at the time of use?
What standardization or topicality status applies to each name, such as official, standardised, historical or other?
From which source or names authority was this name taken?
Which names are historical, local-use, misspellings or otherwise non-current, and for what period were they used?
Is any name flagged pejorative, deprecated or avoid-use, and may it still be used for retrieval of historical sources?
Are indigenous, minority or local-use names recorded, and under what community or authority warrant?
What feature type or named-place type is assigned, in which type scheme, and is a local type also recorded?
If a related spatial object in another theme is linked, is the feature type consistent with that theme?
What alignments exist between this type code and GeoNames, GNIS, TGN, INSPIRE or ADL feature-type concepts?
Is this place classified as an administrative entity, a physical feature, or another facet used by the gazetteer?
Does a physical feature cross administrative boundaries, and under which containing parent is it placed?
If the gazetteer excludes cultural or constructed classes, is this entity in scope or must it be referenced in a sibling model?
What geographic identifier label or code is used as the spatial reference for this location?
If coordinates are absent, what descriptive spatial reference locates this place?
Within the location class and gazetteer, is the geographic identifier unique?
What complementary point position is recorded, in which CRS, and does it represent a centroid, mouth, source or other convention?
What geometry or geographic extent is associated with the named place, and at what precision or viewing resolution?
How approximate are the coordinates, from which source were they taken, and at what event time versus ingestion time?
Is elevation recorded, in what unit, and is it a measurement of the place or of a sampled point?
In which country and administrative units is this place located for gazetteer context, without treating those units as this place?
On which map sheet or topographic map is the place located, if the gazetteer uses map references?
At which least and most detailed viewing resolutions should the named place be displayed?
What is the preferred parent place, and what whole/part or other hierarchical relation type applies?
What additional current, historical or disputed parents exist, and over which time span?
Which child places are contained, and in what sort order should siblings be listed?
What associative relations to other gazetteer places are recorded, with which controlled relation type?
Which neighbouring or nearby features are asserted, and is the relation topological, proximity-based or both?
Which identifiers of spatial objects in other themes represent the same entity as this named place?
Which names authority has jurisdiction to sanction or change the official name of this feature, and in which territory?
What is the current officialization state of the name, including any pending proposal or BGN-equivalent decision date?
What local usage, historical warrant and compelling reason support a proposed new name or name change?
Does a landowner, indigenous community or other owner-decides rule constrain who may propose or approve the name?
Does the named feature still exist on the landscape, is it historical, lost, planned-unbuilt, or merged into another place?
If the precise location is unknown or the place is lost, what historical warrant still justifies a gazetteer record?
If records were merged or split, which surviving identifier is canonical and which former identifiers redirect?
What real-world interval applies to the place type, name use or parent relation, as distinct from database version time?
When was this version of the spatial object inserted, superseded or retired in the gazetteer dataset?
What is the event time of the underlying naming or geometry fact versus the observation or ingestion time of this record?
What published or archival source warrants each name, and where in that source was it found?
Which institution or project contributed each name, note or geometry, and is that form the contributor preferred form?
What quality or confidence applies to the identifier match, coordinates and feature type, and is the record compiled or authority-sanctioned?
If population or similar measurements are present, are they gazetteer finding aids or references to a demographic sibling?
Is location or even existence of this feature publicly disclosable, or is it withheld under cave-protection or other sensitivity law?
Under what licence may the gazetteer record and its names be reused, and what attribution is required?
May historical, pejorative or superseded names be deleted, or must they be retained with flags for retrieval and audit?
What exception process grants an agent access to redacted coordinates or suppressed names?
Through which gazetteer service operations can an agent resolve, search, insert, update or delete this location instance?
Does an exported record include the UNGEGN minimum of standardized name, feature type and location, plus any required INSPIRE or ISO fields?
Which encodings are projections of this place rather than alternative semantics, and how is round-trip identity preserved?
Is any conformance claimed to ISO 19112, INSPIRE GN or OGC WFS-G, and what evidence supports the claim?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
